title: Kahtoola MICROspikes Footwear Traction — product specifications
claims: MICROspikes carry twelve stainless steel spikes per foot with a 3/8 in spike length; pair weight is S 11 oz / 312 g, M 11.9 oz / 338 g, L 13.1 oz / 372 g, XL 13.5 oz / 382 g; packed size is 13 x 8 x 5 cm.
The TPE harness retains its elasticity down to -22 F (-30 C); an integrated toe bail keeps the toe from pushing through the harness, and a raised heel tab aids donning with cold or gloved hands.

The product is best suited to hiking, backpacking and trekking on steep mountainous terrain; care is lukewarm water wash and air-dry, inspect before each use, and remove the device from footwear between uses.
